items.quote:
A travel signature is relevant only to J-1 scholars (and their dependents) who are planning to travel abroad and return to the U.S. in J status. You do not need a travel signature to leave the U.S.
Check to See if You Need a Travel Signature Now You will need an unexpired travel signature on the date you re-enter the U.S. You should use your most recently issued DS-2019 for travel.
